title: High school SETI@home club crunching Arecibo data
place_text: Arecibo radio telescope data; Shkreli's high school, US

tellings.quote: formed our high school club for seti at home and it was like three people and we all contributed our screen saver compute time

plain: The former pharmaceutical executive Martin Shkreli tells Michels that in the late 1990s he started a SETI@home club at his high school. SETI@home was a program that let home computers help sort through data from the Arecibo radio telescope in Puerto Rico, looking for signals from aliens. He says the club had about three members, who all gave their computers' screen-saver time to the search.
